(#{item.id}, #{item.thirdProgramId}, #{item.programName},#{item.categoryName}, #{item.tenant}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.createBy},#{item.creatorId},#{item.creatorType}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy},#{item.updaterId},#{item.updaterType}, #{item.updateTime})

mapper.select:
SELECT a.`id`, a.`third_program_id`, a.`program_name`, a.`category_name`, a.`tenant`, a.`deleted`,a.`create_by`, a.`create_time`, a.`update_by`, a.`update_time` FROM `program` a where a.`deleted` = 0
and a.`program_name` like concat('%', #{param.programName}, '%')
and a.`category_name` like concat('%', #{param.categoryName}, '%')
order by a.`create_time` DESC
